sources.evidence_extract: SP3T; POS.1 ON terminals 1-3, POS.2 ON 2-3, POS.3 ON 3-4 (terminal 3 common). Contact rating 0.3A @ 6 VDC; electrical life 10,000 cycles; contact resistance 70 mOhm max; operating temperature -10..+85 C for PCM13SMTR; solderability 255 C max; tape & reel 3500. Outline: body 9.7 long, 2.6 deep, 1.4 high; actuator 1.3 wide projecting 1.5 beyond the body edge, 1.5 travel per position; two 0.8 dia locating pegs 0.5 long at 5.0 pitch; land pattern holes 0.9 typ.
